patch_description: This crossover combines the concave direct-link and endpoint-volume rewards from the inspiration program with the current program’s demand-sensitive two-hop signal and edge-pressure discount. Rather than rewarding every candidate route independently, it divides each OD pair’s bounded indirect-reward budget among its intermediate nodes. Transit-node capacity and direct-edge pressure shape that allocation, while a uniform component keeps weaker alternatives represented. This retains at most one quadratic term per two-hop path and stays within the requested term limit.
